purpose: Stop technically correct but visually weak gameplay captures from reaching Kevin, the website, social channels or distribution partners.

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Keep the now-readable creature action, but stage it as a dramatic foreground event inside a richly layered place, with the creature and the changed route dominating the composition and almost no explanatory text.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Keep the plain choice, then return to the same clean camera position and make one large recognisable part of the world transform through colour, movement, life or structure so the result is felt before it is read.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Replace the ring-and-echo treatment with one large impossible alien behaviour in the world, such as matter flowing upward or light folding into a path, and frame both characters reacting to it in a quiet uncluttered space.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Record a six-to-ten-second route through a richly layered alien biome with an immediate goal, one readable movement challenge, a living world reaction and a rewarding payoff while both characters stay large enough to recognise.

captureOutcome.meaning: The capture system is now reliable. The remaining failure is the human-facing quality and composition of the playable scenes, so editing or distribution cannot solve it.

nextGate.request: Treat each launch moment as a small piece of visual storytelling inside the game: larger readable actors, richer alien places, less interface clutter, and a clear action or transformation with an emotional payoff.
